prompt: Use case: production enemy body candidate for a 2D Unity survivor game. ENEMY-008, Mounted Royal Scout. Create ONE isolated full-body combined RIDER AND SMALL PONY sprite on genuinely transparent square canvas, no ground shadow. This must unmistakably read as a human rider mounted on a compact horse at 256px, not a foot soldier or centaur. The horse is a sturdy short-legged chestnut pony with head turned right, mane in chunky shapes and all hooves on one level ground-contact line; the rider wears a dusty royal-blue short cloak, simple light guard helmet and has alert focused posture. Three-quarter top-down orthographic gameplay view, moving/facing RIGHT and slightly toward viewer. Keep the rider and horse as one compact silhouette that can fit a single centered circular contact profile: short muzzle and tail, no long spear, no long waving cloak, no extreme outstretched limbs; show the horse's neck, saddle and four sturdy legs clearly. Warm ironic fairy-tale chase, 2D hand-drawn storybook cutout, thick slightly irregular charcoal-plum outline, 3–5 large color masses, matte muted chestnut, blue and cream, simple cel shading, restrained paper texture. Generous transparent padding around complete silhouette, visible body ~70–78% of square canvas height. No scenery, dust, speed lines, weapons firing, text, border, pixel art, pseudo-3D rendering, green goblin skin.
